source.sourceText: If it's an artifact or creature card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand.
If you put a card into your hand this way, create a Food token and transform this enchantment.
Cooking Campsite — {3}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

sink.sourceText: At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. If it's an artifact or creature card...
Cooking Campsite — Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control (needs creatures to benefit).
